entries.message: holds no <input type="checkbox">, so it has nothing to serve: there is no default render, because a control the script made would be no control before the script runs.
entries.fix: Write the input inside it: <vera-checkbox><label><input type="checkbox" name="…"> Label</label></vera-checkbox>.

entries.message: holds an input with no accessible name (its labels, aria-label, aria-labelledby and title give no text), so a screen reader announces only "checkbox".
entries.fix: Put text in its <label>, give it a <label for>, or wrap it in <vera-field> with a <label>.
